title: Classroom/lab with projection screens, benches and seated participants

Exact headcount beyond 11 cannot be determined with certainty due to partial occlusion.

At least one ceiling-mounted projector is visible suspended near the centre of the ceiling above the room; additional ceiling-mounted hardware and cabling are visible across the ceiling.

At least four large rectangular high workbenches or tables with light-coloured wooden tops and white metal frames are visible in the foreground and midground (one foremost table, one center table, one left table where people sit, and one long table to the right).
Multiple round stools are visible around the benches; at least 13 individual stools are distinguishable in the foreground and midground (some stools are partially obscured).
Several desktop monitors are visible: two monitors on the window ledge under the windows (left-mid background) and at least one monitor on the equipment bench at the far-right background.

Three or more yellow ceiling-mounted cable reels or hose reels are visible attached to the exposed ceiling infrastructure.
A single tall white cylindrical bottle or container sits on the centre foreground table.
